headline: PBOC to push overnight reverse repo ceiling to 1 trillion yuan next week | METROHK.com.hk
summary: The People's Bank of China will conduct overnight reverse repo operations from September 28 to October 8 with a daily cap of 1 trillion yuan, up from 600 billion in mid-August.
why: The People's Bank of China is China's central bank, and its liquidity operations shape short-term funding conditions for the banking system.
why_moved: The central bank is expanding reverse repo operations to meet short-term liquidity needs of the banking system.
